questions.question: What does CSS stand for?
questions.explanation: CSS is Cascading Style Sheets, used to style HTML elements.

questions.question: Which property changes text color?
questions.explanation: The color property sets text color in CSS.

questions.question: Which property sets background color?
questions.explanation: background-color sets the background color of elements.

questions.question: How do you select an element with id='header'?
questions.explanation: The # symbol selects elements by their id attribute.

questions.question: How do you select elements with class='button'?
questions.explanation: The dot . selects elements by their class attribute.

questions.question: Which property controls text size?
questions.explanation: font-size controls the size of text.

questions.question: Which layout model uses rows and columns?
questions.explanation: CSS Grid creates two-dimensional layouts with rows and columns.

questions.question: What property adds space inside an element's border?
questions.explanation: Padding creates space between content and border.

questions.question: Which property controls element opacity?
questions.explanation: opacity sets transparency from 0 to 1.

questions.question: What layout model creates one-dimensional layouts?
questions.explanation: Flexbox creates flexible single-direction layouts.

questions.question: Which property adds space outside an element's border?
questions.explanation: margin creates space outside an element's border.

questions.question: Which property makes text bold?
questions.explanation: font-weight: bold thickens text strokes.

questions.question: Which property removes the underline from links?
questions.explanation: text-decoration: none removes underlines.

questions.question: Which position value keeps an element fixed during scrolling?
questions.explanation: position: fixed pins elements to the viewport.

questions.question: Which selector targets every element on the page?
questions.explanation: The universal selector * matches all elements.

questions.question: Which property controls the space between lines of text?
questions.explanation: line-height sets the vertical spacing of text lines.

questions.question: Which property changes the mouse cursor icon on hover?
questions.explanation: cursor sets the pointer style shown on hover.

questions.question: How do you write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: CSS comments use slash-star delimiters.

questions.question: Which unit is relative to the root element's font size?
questions.explanation: rem scales relative to the html root font size.

questions.question: Which declaration hides an element but keeps its layout space?
questions.explanation: visibility: hidden hides elements while preserving their space.

questions.question: Which pseudo-class selects the first child of a parent?
questions.explanation: :first-child matches an element that is its parent's first child.

questions.question: Which property transforms text to uppercase?
questions.explanation: text-transform: uppercase capitalizes text.

questions.question: Which property sets spacing between characters?
questions.explanation: letter-spacing adjusts the space between characters.

questions.question: Which display value creates a flex container?
questions.explanation: display: flex enables flexbox layout on a container.

questions.question: Which at-rule applies styles only at certain screen widths?
questions.explanation: @media queries apply styles conditionally by viewport.

questions.question: Which property sets the space between grid or flex items?
questions.explanation: gap sets row and column spacing between items.

questions.question: An e-commerce card must switch from stacked to side-by-side only when the sidebar containing it is at least 320px wide, regardless of screen size. Which feature implements this?
questions.explanation: Container queries react to the containing element's size; media queries only see the viewport.

questions.question: A promo banner should remain visible at the top while its section scrolls, then scroll away once that section ends. Which declaration does this?
questions.explanation: Sticky positioning pins an element within its scroll container's bounds instead of the whole viewport like fixed.

questions.question: A user enabled reduce motion in their OS settings and animations now nauseate them on a store site. Which media query lets the site honor that preference?
questions.explanation: prefers-reduced-motion lets CSS swap animations for instant states when the user opts out of motion.

questions.question: A modal with z-index: 9999 still renders under a navbar because an ancestor has transform: translateX(0). Why?
options: the transform creates a new stacking context that confines the modal's z-index
questions.explanation: transform, opacity < 1, and filter create stacking contexts; z-index only competes within its own context.

questions.question: Two rules hit the same price text: `.sale .price { color: red }` and `#deal .price { color: green }`. Which color applies and why?
options: red, because later class rules win
green, because the ID selector gives higher specificity
questions.explanation: Specificity (1,1,0) for the ID-based selector beats (0,2,0) for the two-class selector.
